title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Kɔkyɛ kwan mu kyɛfa biara so nhwehwɛmu
bridge: Wɔ Twirekan nee asɛm a ɛte saa so, nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ den koraa no, ɛsiane adverbials a wɔde maa kyɛfa no yɛ den koraa (e.g., 'somewhat', 'arguably'), modal verbs a wɔde maa toa so nhwehwɛmu (e.g., 'might', 'could'), nee sɛm a wɔde maa hyɛn saa (e.g., 'although', 'while'). Sɛnea ɛte nka Twirekan, ɛno akyi, wɔde subjunctive mood (sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ) maa nhwehwɛmu no yɛ den koraa, nanso wɔ Twirekan no, wɔde sɛm a wɔde maa hyɛn saa nee sɛm a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan no maa yɛ den koraa. Sɛm bi a ɛyɛ den koraa wɔ Twirekan no, ɛne sɛ wɔde 'aunque pudiera ser' maa hyɛn saa, nanso wɔ Twirekan no, wɔde 'although it could be' anaa 'while it might be' maa yɛ den koraa.
rule: Saa ara na wɔde maa kɔkyɛ kyɛfa biara so nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ den koraa wɔ Twirekan no: 1) Adverbials a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan (e.g., 'arguably', 'apparently', 'probably') maa kyerɛw wo kwan. 2) Modal verbs a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan (might, may, could) maa kyerɛw wo kwan a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan. 3) Sɛm a wɔde maa hyɛn saa (although, even though, while, whereas) maa kyerɛw wo kwan a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan. 4) Sɛm a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan (it could be argued that..., one might say that..., this is not to say that...) maa kyerɛw wo kwan a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan. Hwɛ kwan a wɔde maa kyerɛw wo kwan no: wɔ Twirekan no, wɔde sɛm a wɔde maa hyɛn saa no maa kyerɛw wo kwan anaa maa kyerɛw wo kwan akyiri, nanso ɛmmɛn nhwɛso nee sɛm a ɛde maa kyerɛw wo kwan so. Mfa 'maybe' (a ɛyɛ den koraa) wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ den koraa no mu; de 'perhaps' anaa 'possibly' maa yɛ den koraa.

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Nkontompo ne Ndwomaseɛ Kyerew
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛbɛka nkontobire ne ndwomaseɛ kyerew ho asɛm wɔ mmerɛ a ɛte saa ara na yɛbɛka 'me da biara', 'ɛsɛ sɛ yɛka' anaa yɛnkyerɛkyerɛ. Wɔ English, ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔhwɛ modal verbs (may, might, could) ma wɔatwa so ama wɛkɛ nea ɛyɛ paa, adverbs of degree (highly, somewhat, arguably) ne impersonal opinion structures (It is worth noting). Ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛka 'must' ho nhia wɔde wɔ Twi a ɛbɛka 'debe ser', na wɔ English 'must' kyerɛkyerɛ logical deduction a ɛyɛ den paa, na ɛnte ase kan. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnnu nea wɔbɛka ma wɔnnyɛ brusk: wɔ English wɔde 'I would argue' nkyerɛkyerɛ 'I think definitely'.
rule: Ma woka nkontobire ne ndwomaseɛ kyerew wɔ English a ɛte C1, hwɛ: 1) Modal verbs ma wɔatwa so ama wɛkɛ nea ɛyɛ paa: 'must' (certainty), 'may/might/could' (possibility), 'can't' (impossibility). 2) Adverbs of degree: 'highly', 'extremely', 'somewhat', 'arguably', 'undoubtedly'. 3) Impersonal structures: 'It is worth noting that...', 'It could be argued that...', 'The evidence suggests...'. 4) Opinion verbs: 'I would argue', 'I contend', 'I maintain' (more formal than 'I think'). 5) Contrast connectors: 'however', 'nevertheless', 'whereas'. Mfa 'I think' ho nhia wɔ academic writing; de 'This implies that...' anaa 'It could be inferred that...' nkyerɛkyerɛ. Ma wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ, de 'strengths and weaknesses', 'implications', 'limitations'.

common_error.wrong: I think that the author is right, but the article is not good because it doesn't have examples.
common_error.correct: While the author makes a valid point, the article would be stronger if it included concrete examples.
common_error.correct_alt: Although the author's argument is plausible, the lack of specific examples weakens the overall analysis.
common_error.explanation: Spanish speakers bɛka 'I think' ho nhia ne wɔde tone a ɛte categorical. Wɔ English academic, wɔhwɛ 'would', 'could', 'arguably' ma wɔatwa so ama wɛkɛ nea ɛyɛ paa ne wɔmfa absolute judgments a ɛte saa 'not good' (too informal). Enti, de 'while/although' ma wɔbɛka contrast ne 'would be stronger if' ma wɔde suggestions a ɛbɛyɛ paa.

title: Irony and Understatement / Ironi, Sarcasmo ne Eufemismo
bridge: Wɔ Twiriso, ironija ne sarcasmo bɛbu ahyɛdeɛ ne nsɛmfuodwom a wɔn ho hwehweɛ (sɛ nea ɛyɛ sɛ 'claro', 'por supuesto', 'como no'), na wɔn a wɔatwa so ara na wɔde kyerɛw wɔn ho kyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ahemma anaa wɔyɛ akɔntɔmma. Wɔ Hɔlifo, ironija yɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm ne nsɛmfuo a wɔn ho hwehweɛ, na eufemismo nso yɛ akwan a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ. Ahemma bi: wɔ Hɔlifo, understatement (sɛ nea ɛyɛ sɛ 'not bad' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'excellent') yɛ ironija a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm, na ɛno ara na Hispanohablantes bɛbu ahyɛdeɛ a wɔn ho hwehweɛ, na wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm sɛ 'no está mal', na wɔn ho hwehweɛ. Ansa na, hwɛ: sarcasmo wɔ Hɔlifo bɛbu ahyɛdeɛ a wɔn ho hwehweɛ, na nsɛmfuo a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm yɛ ahemma a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm.
rule: Wɔ Hɔlifo C1, ironija ne eufemismo yɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm: 1) Understatement: deɛ wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ (sɛ nea ɛyɛ sɛ 'It's not the worst idea' = 'ɛyɛ ahemma paa'; 'a bit' anaa 'slightly' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ). 2) Sarcasmo: wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ, na wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ (sɛ nea ɛyɛ sɛ 'Oh, great!', 'Well, that's just perfect' anaa 'I love it when...'). 3) Eufemismo: deɛ wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ (sɛ nea ɛyɛ sɛ 'passed away' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'died', 'let go' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'fired', 'between jobs' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'unemployed', 'full-figured' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'fat'). Ahyɛdeɛ a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm: adverbios de grado ('hardly', 'barely', 'scarcely') sɛ wɔde kyerɛw understatement; rhetorical questions ('Is that so?') sɛ wɔde kyerɛw ironija; ahyɛdeɛ a wɔde kyerɛw 'just', 'only', 'a bit' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw mitigators. Exceptions: context so ara nni ironija; wɔ ahemma a wɔn ho hwehweɛ, sarcasmo a wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm nni. Eufemismo bɛbu ahyɛdeɛ a wɔn ho hwehweɛ: wɔ ahemma a wɔn ho hwehweɛ, wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm. Sɛ wɔde kyerɛw Hispanohablante: deɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'no está mal' (ɛnyɛ understatement wɔ Hɔlifo, na wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm sɛ wɔn ho hwehweɛ), na deɛ wɔde kyerɛw 'not too bad' anaa 'not bad at all' sɛ wɔde kyerɛw ho asɛm a wɔn ho hwehweɛ.

title: Indirect Speech Acts and Implicature / Nkyerɛasefoɔ ne Nnyinasosɛm
bridge: Wɔ Twi, nkyerɛasefoɔ mma bu a wɔde tonni anaa mfatohoɔ mma wɔ ‘Se wo betua me nsuo?’ a wɔyɛ mma wɔn a wɔtwa so ara. Wɔ Gyenman, nkyerɛasefoɔ mma yɛ den na wɔde mmara nsɛm (could, would), nsɛmfua a ɛnyɛ nokware, ne sɛe (I was wondering) ma wɔn a wɔbɛka ahwɛ. Mmɛbɔɔ a wɔde kasa Gyenman no sɛ wɔyɛ mma wɔn a wɔtwa so ara, na ɛsɛe na ɛbɛba mframa anaa ɛbɛba mframa. Ɛkwan so, nnyinasosɛm a ɛwɔ kwan so (nnyinasosɛm) te sɛe a ɛwɔ mmerɛ no; wɔ Gyenman, wɔbɔɔ nea ɛnyɛ nokware no so sɛ obi bɛma no akwan, nanso nsɛm a ɛwɔ kwan so no ne mmerɛ no.
rule: Wɔ Gyenman, wɔde mfatohoɔ mma a wɔde: 1) Nsɛmfua a wɔde 'can/could/would you...' ma wɔn a wɔbɛka ahwɛ (Could you close the window?), 2) 'I was wondering if...' ma wɔn a wɔbɛka ahwɛ a wɔyɛ mma wɔn a wɔtwa so ara (I was wondering if you could help me), 3) Nsɛmfua a ɛnyɛ nokware ma wɔn a wɔbɛka ahwɛ anaa nsɛmfua (Don't you think it's too late?), 4) 'It might be a good idea to...' ma wɔn a wɔbɛka ahwɛ a wɔnyɛ mma wɔn a wɔtwa so ara. Sɛ wɔde nnyinasosɛm no, wɔde Grice sɛe a ɛwɔ kwan so; ɛne mfatohoɔ, 'I'm cold' ne sɛ wo bɛka sɛ wo bɛka ahwɛ. Wɔ C1, wɔbɔɔ nea ɛwɔ kwan so ne nea ɛnyɛ nokware no so sɛ wɔbɛka ahwɛ. Mfa nsɛm a ɛwɔ Twi no mfa Gyenman; ɛne mfatohoɔ, '¿Puedes cerrar la ventana?' ne 'Can you close the window?' nanso wɔ kwan a ɛwɔ kwan so no, wɔde 'Would you mind closing the window?' anaa 'Could you possibly close the window?'.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Ɛbɔkrakye Abasɛm a ɛte Sɛɛ
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛnkyɛm yɛn ara yɛde asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan te saa 'wɔ nkasɛ', 'wɔ nkyɛn biara' anaa 'wɔ kyerɛw' ma yɛde yɛn asɛm kwan. Wɔ English, kwan kyerɛw no sɛɛ ne mfatoho, na wɔde asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan te saa 'firstly', 'furthermore', 'but more importantly', na 'in light of this'. Ɛbɔkrakye a ɛte sɛɛ no, wɔde 'por un lado' kyerɛw 'on one side' nti, na ɛnyɛ 'on the one hand', anaa wɔde 'in conclusion' kyerɛw 'to sum up' anaa 'ultimately' wɔ hɔ a wɔde no kyerɛw. Enti, wɔde asɛm a ɛte sɛɛ na ɛso awaree no yɛ ɛha, na wɔde asɛm a ɛte sɛɛ na ɛso pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ English, na wɔde asɛm a ɛte sɛɛ na ɛso awaree wɔ Twi.
rule: Wɔ ɛbɔkrakye a ɛte sɛɛ wɔ English (C1) no, wɔde asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan te saa 'I would like to begin by...', 'Let me start by...', anaa 'The purpose of this presentation is to...'. Ma wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan: 'Firstly', 'Secondly', 'Furthermore', 'Moreover', 'In addition'. Ma wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan a ɛne εha: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'Nevertheless'. Ma wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan a ɛte sɛɛ: 'Indeed', 'In fact', 'It is important to note that'. Ma wɔde kyerɛw wo kwan a ɛte sɛɛ: 'In conclusion', 'To summarize', 'In light of the evidence'. Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔde 'it's' kyerɛw 'it is' na wɔde asɛm a ɛnyɛ sɛɛ. Enti, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde 'we' kyerɛw (saa 'we can see that...'). Enti, wɔde asɛm a ɛte sɛɛ na ɛso pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ English, na wɔde asɛm a ɛte sɛɛ na ɛso awaree wɔ Twi.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Kɔbɔkye ne Nnɔmba mu Ahwehwɛbɔsɛm ne Nnipa-mmara
bridge: Wɔ Twi, mmusua bɛka subjunctive ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ ‘sɛ’, ‘n’asɛm’ anaa ‘sɛ wɔbɛyɛ’ ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ ahwehwɛbɔsɛm, nanso wɔ English academic writing mu, hedging yɛ wɔde modal verbs, probability adverbs ne opinion verbs a wɔwɔ hɔ bio a wɔde ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ ‘suggest’ anaa ‘appear’. Mmusu pii a wɔyɛ ne sɛ wɔde ‘es posible que’ kyerɛ ‘it is possible that’, na ɛyɛ nanso ɛnte saa a wɔbɛka ho asɛm a ɛyɛ paa a wɔbɛka ‘may’ anaa ‘could’. Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛnnyane hedging pii: wɔ English academic writing mu, wɔto so ara ne nnɔmpa, na ɛnte sɛ wɔbɛyɛ ahwehwɛbɔsɛm pii.
rule: Wɔ English academic writing mu, wɔde hedging markers ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn asɛm gu so ne sɛ wɔbɛto wɔn asɛm a wɔde ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛyɛ paa. Nnɔmba a wɔde ne: 1) Modal verbs: may, might, could (e.g., 'This may indicate...'), 2) Frequency/probability adverbs: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (e.g., 'This possibly suggests...'), 3) Opinion verbs: suggest, appear, seem (e.g., 'The data suggest that...'), 4) Impersonal expressions: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Sɛ wɔto boosting (nnɔmba a wɔde ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛyɛ paa), wɔde adverbs a wɔwɔ hɔ bio a wɔde ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ ‘clearly’, ‘undoubtedly’, ‘definitively’, anaa verbs a wɔde ma wɔatwe kyerɛɛ sɛ ‘prove’, ‘demonstrate’. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛmmusua boosting ne hedging: asɛm bɛn na ‘This clearly may be true’ ɛyɛ, efisɛ ɛto hedging ne boosting. Enti, wɔ English academic writing mu, wɔnnyane personal pronoun ‘I’ wɔ mfonini pii mu, na wɔde passive anaa impersonal structures kyerɛ.

translations.tw: Kɔbɔkye ne Nnɔmba mu Ahwehwɛbɔsɛm ne Nnipa-mmara

title: Advanced Negotiation Strategies / Nkitaho kuro akyire kyewaa
bridge: Wɔ Twi, wɔ nkitaho mu, yɛbɛka yɛn ho asɛm a wɔ kyerɛw wo sɛn ara ne mfatoho a wɔde ama no sɛ 'mebɔ wo kwan sɛ' anaa 'yɛn adwene nni hɔ'. Wɔ Gyenman ne Gyenmanfo (English), nkitaho a wɔkɔ so kyerɛw wɔde ahemfo (would, could, might), asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ efisɛ (conditional phrases), ne asɛm a enni kwan (indirect language) ma no ntɛm ne ma wɔhu mfatoho. Nso, Gyenman ne Gyenmanfo de 'unless' ne 'provided that' ma wɔde kyerɛw nnwoma, na nnwoma no nni mfatoho a wɔde ama no sɛn ara wɔ Twi, na sɛ wɔtrene no a efri Twi a, etumiade sɛ ɛbɛma wɔwom nnwoma no ho adwene. Nso, wɔde mfatoho a wɔde ama no sɛ 'I was wondering if' anaa wɔbɛka asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔrebɛka ho asɛm, na sɛ wɔtrene no a efri Twi a, ɛbɛba sɛ asɛm a ɛyɛ den sɛn ara.
rule: Saa ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛka nkitaho a ɛkɔ so wɔ Gyenman ne Gyenmanfo a, su sɛn ara nnwoma no: 1) De nnwoma a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ efisɛ (conditionals) ma wɔde kyerɛw mfatoho a efisɛ (hypothetical scenarios): 'If we were to extend the deadline, we would need a discount'. 2) De ahemfo ma wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔpɛ (modal verbs) ma wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔpɛ ne mfatoho: 'I would suggest', 'We could consider', 'I might be open to'. 3) De asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ (concession and reformulation phrases) de 'although', 'however', 'while' ma wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ anaa wɔde wɔn adwene ma wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ. 4) De mfatoho a wɔde ama no nea wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ (idiomatic expressions and commitment expressions): 'meet you halfway', 'a win-win situation', 'bottom line'. 5) De nnwoma a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ efisɛ (conditionals) de 'unless', 'provided that', 'as long as' ma wɔde kyerɛw nnwoma a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ: 'We can agree, provided that you cover shipping costs'. 6) De asɛm a wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔrebɛka ho asɛm (indirect questions) ma wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔrebɛka ho asɛm: 'I was wondering if you would consider a different payment schedule'. Pa a ɛso: mmom de 'I want' da; de 'I would like' anaa 'We are looking for'. Nnomenu: wɔ nkitaho a ɛyɛ den (hard negotiation) mu, ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde asɛm a ɛyɛ den, na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔpɛ. Hwehwɛ sɛ wɔntrene 'no me gusta' a ɛfri Twi a sɛ 'I don't like it' - wɔ Gyenman ne Gyenmanfo, wɔde 'I'm not entirely comfortable with that' ma wɔde kyerɛw sɛ wɔmmɔ.

title: Nuanced Expression of Attitude / Kyerɛ asɛm ne nneɛma no ho adwene ne nneɛma no ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmerɛ mmerɛ mu
bridge: Wɔ Twi mu, yɛbɛka yɛn adwene ne nneɛma no ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmerɛ mmerɛ mu kyerɛw wɔ mmerɛ mmerɛ mu adwuma (sɛ 'me pa ara na mehu sɛ', 'wɔ me nsa na mehu sɛ'). Wɔ English mu, na wɔdɔpɔ adverbials ne modal verbs sɛ 'would', 'might', 'may' ne mmerɛ sɛ 'I'd say' anaa 'I'd argue' ma wɔatwa anaa wɔahyɛ adwene. Mmerɛ pii wɔde 'I believe that' kyerɛ 'me pa ara na mehu sɛ' wɔ mmerɛ na Englishfoɔ bɛka 'arguably' anaa 'presumably'. Yɛn adwene ne sɛ yɛbɛka yɛn ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmerɛ mmerɛ mu wɔ mmerɛ mu adwuma, adverbials ne mmerɛ sɛ 'would' ne 'might'.
rule: Ma wɔbɛka adwene ne nneɛma no ho nhyehyɛe wɔ mmerɛ mmerɛ mu wɔ English mu wɔ C1 level mu, wɔdɔ: (1) Modal verbs (may, might, could, would, should) ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mmerɛ, permission, suggestion anaa condition; (2) Adverbials (arguably, admittedly, typically, surprisingly) ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ adwene anaa nneɛma no ho nhyehyɛe; (3) Impersonal constructions (It's fair to say, It could be argued that) ma wɔatwa adwene; (4) Verbs (I'd suggest, I'd maintain, I'd contend) ne 'would' ma wɔatwa. Wɔ negative mu, wɔdɔ 'not' + 'at all', 'hardly', 'scarcely' ma wɔahyɛ mmerɛ. Wɔbɛyɛ sɛ wɔntumi nnyɛ 'I think' anaa 'I believe' wɔ mmerɛ. Wɔ formal speech mu, wɔpɛ 'It would seem that' anaa 'It might be argued'.

title: Register Shifting / Kyere kyere akyire akyerɛwfoɔ ne nnwom a ɛyɛ adwuma
bridge: Wɔ Twi, akyerɛwfoɔ rekɔ so ara na ɛyɛ akyire kyerewfoɔ, sɛ 'wɔ' ne 'ono' anaa mmara a ɛyɛ adwuma. Wɔ English, akyerɛwfoɔ nni wɔ mmara a ɛyɛ adwuma, noko wɔ de asɛm, nnwom a ɛyɛ adwuma ne sɛ wɔde kyerɛwfoɔ anaa mmara a ɛyɛ adwuma ma no. Akanifoɔ a wɔde Twi kasa biara bɛbu akyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma anaa a ɛyɛ akwan anaa a ɛyɛ akwan, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma so. Ɛyɛ a wɔde kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma ma no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma so (sɛ 'I was wondering if...') ne 'hedging' ('might', 'could', 'perhaps') ma wɔakɔ so.
rule:
Wɔ English, akyerɛwfoɔ rekɔ so ara na ɛyɛ akyire kyerewfoɔ (akyire, anidaso, akwan) de asɛm a ɛdi kan so:

1. Asɛm: Asɛm a ɛyɛ adwuma ne a ɛyɛ akwan (sɛ 'purchase' vs 'buy', 'receive' vs 'get', 'child' vs 'kid').
2. Sintaxis: Nnwom a ɛyɛ adwuma (sɛ nnwom a ɛyɛ adwuma, kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma) kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma pii; nnwom a ɛyɛ akwan ne a ɛyɛ akwan kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ akwan.
3. Modales ne hedges: 'Would', 'could', 'might', 'perhaps', 'possibly' ma wɔatwa so wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma; wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ akwan wɔde 'can', 'will', 'maybe'.
4. Phrasal verbs: Wɔma wɔn ho asɛm wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ akwan anaa a ɛyɛ anidaso; wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔde mmara a ɛfi Latin (sɛ 'to carry out' vs 'to execute').
5. Contracciones: Wɔntwa wɔn ho asɛm wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma (wɔnni 'don't' noko 'do not').
6. Fórmulas fijas: Wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma ne a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔde mmara a ɛdi kan ('Dear Sir/Madam', 'Yours faithfully').
7. Pronombres: Ɛwom sɛ wɔnni akyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma sɛ 'tú/usted', noko sɛ wɔde 'one' na wɔntwa 'you' ma no ho asɛm a ɛyɛ adwuma ne a ɛyɛ anidaso (sɛ 'One must consider...').

Excepciones: English a wɔde wɔ Britain bɛbu akyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma pii wɔ mmara a wɔde ma no ho asɛm a ɛyɛ adwuma. Wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ akwan a ɛyɛ adwuma, ɛyɛ a wɔde asɛm a ɛyɛ akwan ne emoticon ma no ho asɛm, noko wɔ kyerɛwfoɔ a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔde no ho asɛm. Akyerɛwfoɔ nni nko ara na ɛyɛ asɛm, noko ɛyɛ entonation ne ahoɔden a ɛyɛ adwuma, sɛ sɛ wɔde 'please' ne 'thank you' pii paa wɔ Twi.

title: Pragmatic Styles in Cross-Cultural Communication / Dwuma ne Nneɛma a Wɔwɔ Ho Adwuma mu Abasabasa
bridge: Wɔ Twiriso, anigye ne kyerɛw a wɔnni ho nhyehyɛ bɛka ho nhyɛso wɔ adwuma a wɔde bɛka (dwuma a wɔde bɛka, nneɛma a wɔde bɛka, nneɛma a wɔde bɛka). Wɔ Gyeman, sɛe gyina dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso ne dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso, wɔpɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ne dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso. Wɔ Twiriso, wɔde dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso ne dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso, na wɔde dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso ne dwuma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso. Nneɛma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso: 'maybe' nni 'quizás' na 'baje el tono'; 'I think' wɔ Gyeman de bɛka ho nhyehyɛ wɔ 'creo' wɔ Twiriso.
rule: Wɔ Gyeman, wɔde nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ho nhyɛso: 1) Nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ('sort of', 'kind of', 'I'd say'), 2) Nneɛma a wɔde bɛka wɔ akɔntɔ (would, could, might) ma wɔde bɛka ho nhyehyɛ, 3) Asɛm a wɔde bɛka anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ('couldn't we...?'), 4) Nneɛma a wɔde bɛka 'I'm afraid', 'I'd rather'. Wɔ Twiriso, wɔde nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ho nhyɛso ('me gustaría', 'podrías'), na wɔde nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ho nhyɛso. Wɔ kyerɛw, wɔ Gyeman de 'I see your point, but...' de bɛka ho nhyehyɛ, na wɔ Twiriso 'no estoy de acuerdo' yɛ pa. Ma C1, de 'just' ne 'actually' de bɛka ho nhyehyɛ.

common_error.correct: I see your point, but I'm not sure that's the best idea.

common_error.explanation: Wɔ Twiriso, 'No estoy de acuerdo, es una mala idea' yɛ pa na yɛ pa. Wɔ Gyeman, adi kan no yɛ ɔhaw ne anigye. Nneɛma a wɔwɔ ho nhyɛso: 'I see your point' anaa 'I'm afraid' ma wɔde bɛka ho nhyehyɛ. Fa nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ho nhyɛso; de nneɛma a wɔde bɛka ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛka.
